description: This script defines a utility class 'ContainerRequestUtils' with static methods for extracting and filtering container creation and listing parameters from passed dictionaries, converting optional parameters into specific request parameter objects or filtered dictionaries based on supported configuration.

classes.name: ContainerRequestUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to handle container-related request parameters, including extraction and filtering based on supported configurations.

methods.name: ContainerCreateOptionalRequestParams get_requested_container_create_optional_param( passed_params: dict, )
methods.description: Extracts valid optional container creation parameters from the provided dictionary.

methods.name: Dict get_optional_params_container_create( container_provider_config: BaseContainerConfig, container_create_optional_params: ContainerCreateOptionalRequestParams, )
methods.description: Filters optional container creation parameters based on supported parameters from a container provider configuration.

methods.name: ContainerListOptionalRequestParams get_requested_container_list_optional_param( passed_params: dict, )
methods.description: Extracts valid optional parameters for listing containers from the provided dictionary.
